name: Nadia
bio: Nadia works full time for Obedience Unleashed and is studying toward a Bachelor’s Degree in Nursing. She brings a wealth of experience with animals, living on their family farm raising cows, goats, sheep and chickens. She also has two dogs: a Doberman named Ace and Great Pyrenees named Angel. Nadia’s hobbies include baking, reading and spending time with animals.
